units.summary: New test evicts a series via CompactSelectedSeries, forces WAL truncation/checkpoint, and asserts the evicted series record remains in the checkpoint. Mirrors the stale-head variant.
units.headline: New test: evicted selected series stays in WAL checkpoint
units.reason: New test only; no production behavior change.

units.summary: Generalizes gcStaleSeries into gcSeries taking an eviction predicate. numStaleSeries is now decremented only by the count of deleted series that were actually stale, instead of all removed series.
units.headline: Head GC takes eviction predicate; stale counter decremented only for stale series
units.reason: Changes gauge accounting and series eviction logic in the head.
focus: numStaleSeries decrement uses staleSeriesDeleted, not total removed
Counters stay consistent with numSeries for non-stale evictions

units.summary: Stripe-level GC now delegates the eviction decision to a caller-provided predicate and counts deleted series that are stale. The stale check is moved into isStaleSeries and used for counting.
units.headline: stripeSeries GC uses shouldEvict predicate and counts stale deletions
units.reason: Core series deletion logic changed; stale-count correctness depends on it.
focus: isStaleSeries evaluated at delete time under the series lock, consistent with the shouldEvict check
Stale counting matches how numStaleSeries is incremented elsewhere
